source: stand-in: hand-written control for W3.14: a fee said in digits with its unit is an amount, read as a quantity, so no number check fires; not a model run.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, this is Asha from Sunrise Family Clinic. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: How much does it cost to see the doctor?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: And is my data safe with you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes. Your details stay with the clinic. Would you like an appointment?
